## Context / Problem

Gerrit review of change 1874 observed that `docs/event-schema.md` lists six canonical LINK relations but omits the already-supported `caused_by` relation. The packaged CLI overview lists `caused_by`, and closed task `isogonal-wedded-catfish` is the design/implementation authority adding it as the seventh directional, non-blocking, non-cycle-inducing relation.

## Investigation and repair plan

- Reproduce the maintained-documentation mismatch against current `origin/main` and cite the authoritative implementation/design surfaces.
- Under rebar-debug, prove whether the omission is a stale inventory rather than a runtime defect.
- Add a held-out documentation contract that parses the LINK/UNLINK row and requires set equality with `rebar.graph._links.CANONICAL_RELATIONS`, preventing any future relation omission; retain an explicit `caused_by` semantics assertion as this bug's RED anchor.
- Repair only the proven documentation omission, run exact-defect mutation, focused documentation gates, lint, and typecheck.

## Testing / Verification

- Run `pytest tests/interfaces/contracts/test_event_schema_relations.py` before the repair and require set equality to fail specifically with `caused_by` missing from the documented inventory.
- Run the same command after the repair and require it to pass.
- Remove `caused_by` from the repaired event-schema row, rerun the focused test, require RED, then restore the repair.
- Run `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and the focused documentation-contract suite.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docs/event-schema.md` includes `caused_by` in the canonical LINK relation inventory.
- [ ] The parsed event-schema LINK inventory equals `CANONICAL_RELATIONS` as a set.
- [ ] The event-schema relation prose states `caused_by` is directional.
- [ ] The event-schema relation prose states `caused_by` is non-blocking and non-cycle-inducing.
- [ ] `pytest tests/interfaces/contracts/test_event_schema_relations.py` is RED before repair with `caused_by` as the sole missing canonical relation.
- [ ] The same focused test is GREEN after repair.
- [ ] The exact omission mutation returns the focused test to RED.
- [ ] `make lint` passes.
- [ ] `make typecheck` passes.
